name: gaganyaan the crew / descent module alone (entry)
note: Crew spacecraft render model (tools/make_crew_models.py), the crew / descent module alone (entry). Gaganyaan in orbit: a docking port on the crew module's apex (an estimate: Gaganyaan G1 has none; the scenario's Bharatiya crews dock), service module and two wings. Body frame: +Z out of the docking port, origin at the port's contact point.
